title: Stale or empty feed
purpose: Distinguish a valid empty feed from an upstream feed that crosses the fixed freshness boundary without treating retained observations as current.

entryEvidence.observation: A bounded incident record classifies the selected policy epoch as upstream-stale.
The operations projection reports the fixed stale state and bounded observation age for an exact region.
The aggregate operations projection distinguishes a successful valid-empty provider response from provider unavailability.
The aggregate operations projection identifies valid-empty freshness without inventing an observation age.

boundedActions.instruction: Record checkedAt, policy identity, exact region, freshness reason, and observation age from one operations projection.
Inspect at most two later operations projections for the same region and policy identity within ten minutes.
Prepare one disabled-source candidate carrying upstream-stale if the bounded readings do not recover to current.

stopConditions.observation: Stop as ready for a valid-empty receipt only when provider and freshness classifications both identify the empty state.
Stop the recovery check if the selected region crosses the fixed expired freshness boundary.
Stop the recovery check if the regional read no longer provides freshness evidence.
Stop as ready for a receipt after a bounded projection reports current freshness for the same region and policy identity.

rollbackActions.instruction: Keep the last approved safe release unchanged if the disabled candidate or recovery evidence fails verification.
